sources.claimsVerbatim: Für sensibles Haar und empfindliche Kopfhaut | Wohltuend für die Kopfhaut | Fördert den Erhalt einer intakten Hautbarriere | Hält den natürlichen pH-Wert der Kopfhaut in Balance | Verträglichkeit dermatologisch getestet | Das SANTE Sensitiv Care Shampoo enthält eine hochwirksame Pflegeformel¹ für sensible Kopfhaut mit Probiotika und 3-fach Protein Komplex. conflicts.quote: rossmann.de ends '... Parfum (Fragrance)**, Linalool**, Benzyl Salicylate' (no '**', no Vanillin**) and orders the preservatives 'Sodium Chloride, Sodium Benzoate, PCA Ethyl Cocoyl Arginate, Potassium Sorbate'; also 'Sea Salt' instead of 'Maris Sal (Sea Salt)'. Manufacturer and dm: '... Sodium Chloride, PCA Ethyl Cocoyl Arginate, Potassium Sorbate, Sodium Benzoate, Parfum (Fragrance)**, Linalool**, Benzyl Salicylate**, Vanillin**'.
conflicts.resolution: Kept separate, not merged. Rossmann is treated as a truncated/older feed (24 vs 25 effective items; Vanillin missing; preservative order differs); manufacturer + dm agree verbatim, so their list is canonical. Fragrance-allergen Vanillin is the material difference.

canonicalReason: Manufacturer DE page (LOGOCOS/SANTE shop, exact 250 ml, GTIN in schema.org) and dm.de (same GTIN) agree verbatim on the complete 25-item list; identical to the v1.3 capture. Rossmann deviates (truncated/reordered), preserved under conflicts.
normalization: Split the canonical INCI on ',' (or '|' / '•' separators where the source uses them; dm renders a non-breaking hyphen as '|' inside names, e.g. 'COCO|GLUCOSIDE' = 'Coco-Glucoside'); per ingredient: trim, collapse internal whitespace, merge split synonym entries (e.g. 'Aqua (Water, Eau)' stays one item), strip trailing full stop; canonicalInci keeps the published capitalisation/asterisks; for the hash each item is lower-cased; items joined with '|' and sha256 over the UTF-8 string.
notes: The v1.3 formula-source had no GTIN; GTIN 4055297221467 now anchored by manufacturer + dm + Rossmann. Other sizes: 500 ml 4055297221221, 950 ml 4055297221047 (Vorteilsgröße) - not this product.
AVAILABILITY: dm.de shows 'Nicht lieferbar' with no store availability (online). Manufacturer and Rossmann list it as available. Not a delisting by evidence; watch.

Claim-INCI check: Probiotika = Lactococcus Ferment Lysate / Leuconostoc/Radish Root Ferment Filtrate; '3-fach Protein Komplex' = Hydrolyzed Corn / Wheat / Soy Protein; all present. 'Silikonfrei/alkoholfrei' consistent. Contains hydrolyzed wheat and soy protein (relevant for allergen-style notes). No conflict.
Scalp claims are footnoted as instrumental test of shampoo + conditioner combination, not shampoo alone.
